sections.name: DESIGNATION FORM
sentences: This form is to be used by counsel or pro se plaintiff to indicate the category of the case for the purpose of assignment to the appropriate calendar.
The address of the plaintiff and defendant are required.
Civil cases are deemed related when Yes is answered to any of the following questions.
Is this case related to property included in an earlier numbered suit pending or within one year previously terminated action in this court?
